inspection.observation: Paired lighting views show a continuous rounded flattened outline, differently sized rays, and an oval gap in the upper-right region. A crossing pale diagonal fracture is not an animal structure. Compression does not provide depth.
Actual close-up pixels show large star junctions with tapering rays and finer intervening structures. The specimen edge is broken; it cannot supply the missing whole-body outline.
An upper oval interruption is visible with a surrounding rim region; lower outline is damaged. Do not mirror the break into the living basal surface.
Large six-rayed junctions and finer underlying stars are visible on a fragment; these support a size hierarchy, not an exact complete-animal spicule count.

uncertainty_register.status: No uncompressed complete 3D specimen inspected. Globose life form is an explicit published interpretation.
uncertainty_register.policy: Allow only a plainly labelled evidence-informed sac volume; no museum-grade specimen facsimile claim.

uncertainty_register.status: Possible adhesion to hard substrate is ecological inference; exact attachment organs are not established.
uncertainty_register.policy: Complete the lower sac conservatively at a contact region. No stalk, root tuft, cement pad or detached broken edge presented as fact.

uncertainty_register.status: BOTTING2005 proposes mineralogical/phylogenetic hypotheses; museum categorical wording is not proof of settled crown-class identity.
uncertainty_register.policy: Do not call this a definitive modern calcarean or glass sponge; do not use sparkling glass or metallic materials as a scientific claim.

uncertainty_register.status: Life palette, precise ostia spacing, wall thickness and uncompressed aperture dimensions are not measured here.
uncertainty_register.policy: Maker must record selected simplifications as artistic. Retain original geometry; do not trace source images into maps.

sufficiency.basis: Whole outline and aperture are directly visible, with published globose life-form interpretation and diagnostic spicule evidence. Unknown contact anatomy is explicitly excluded rather than filled with invented organs.
sufficiency.hold_trigger: If the requested standard changes to specimen-exact 3D anatomy, attachment apparatus, pore census or museum-grade phylogenetic certainty, HOLD pending the corresponding evidence.
